title: Before/after for the two TDA defects found by the known-answer suite
never_claimed: no result here is 'proved'; the acceptances are numerical checks against pre-declared gates, each with a negative control

calibcheck.question: is #{rank p < 0.05} = 11-12 of 100 a broken exchangeability, or the spread from 100 test vectors sharing ONE 100-member ensemble?
calibcheck.construction: multivariate normal, p = 6, ensemble n = 100, 100 test vectors per ensemble, 100 INDEPENDENT ensembles, np.random.default_rng(777); same fs.conditioned_inverse / Hartlap / pooled-exchangeable code path

chi2_p_branch.note: the branch the acceptance gate actually uses: ONE ensemble mean/cov per ensemble, chi2 survival with df = retained rank, Gaussian data so the reference distribution is exact
chi2_p_branch.implication_for_the_gate: this is the false-failure rate of the declared #{p<0.05} <= 9 clause for a PERFECTLY calibrated statistic, caused by the 100 test maps sharing one ensemble; it is a property of the F3 design, not of the fix

calibcheck.verdict: pooled rate matches the exact uniform target to within Monte-Carlo error, so the pooled-exchangeable rank p is calibrated; the per-ensemble count is over-dispersed relative to binomial by the stated factor because the 100 test vectors share one ensemble

e5.SCOPE: ONLY the statistics defect (D1) is recomputed. The curves themselves were produced by the DEFECTIVE build_topology at nside 128; recomputing them means regenerating 100 synfast sims x 2 filtration directions at nside 128 and is NOT done here. This is not a revalidation of E5.

f1.euler_note: a 256x256 disc has chi = 1 and b0-b1 = 1; both agree here because b2 = 0

guard.verdict: the guard is green on the fixed library and fails on 19 tests when the original implementations are substituted

negctrl.declared_gate: at least 15 of 20 control maps have chi2 p < 0.05 under the FIXED statistic

euler_check_at_final_nu.note: the full sphere has chi = 2 and b0-b1 = 1; the original returned 1 under the name euler_chi

gate_3_disk_mask.mask: nside 32, pixels with z >= cos(30 deg) (a polar cap)

D1_acceptance.gate: KS of the 100 chi2 p-values against U(0,1) has p > 0.05 AND #{p<0.05} <= 9, for b0, b1 and the Euler curve
D1_acceptance.known_caveat: the 100 test p-values share one 100-sim ensemble, so they are correlated; KS against uniform assumes independence and is anti-conservative here. This is a property of the F3 design (commit 033f017), not of the fix.

headline_findings.1_D1_acceptance_met_on_the_declared_case: column C (fixed statistic on the suite's committed F3 curves, which is the case the acceptance names) passes for b0, b1 and the Euler curve: KS p = 0.3864 / 0.2218 / 0.3975, #{p<0.05} = 4 / 9 / 9
headline_findings.2_the_minimal_enumerated_fix_is_not_suff: column B (dead-bin drop + df = kept bins + eigen conditioning, i.e. exactly the three steps enumerated in the defect report) leaves b1 at #{p<0.05} = 10 > 9, KS p = 0.2244. The atomic-bin rule of column C is what closes it. Reported as its own column rather than merged into a single 'after'.
headline_findings.3_full_fixed_pipeline_b1_still_exceeds_t: column D (fixed topology AND fixed statistic) gives b1 KS p = 0.3864 (passes) but #{p<0.05} = 11 (the gate allows 9), so the gate as declared is NOT met for b1 on the recomputed curves. The threshold is not moved: --step calibcheck measures, on exactly Gaussian data with the same code path, P(#{p<0.05} >= 11) = 0.04 for a PERFECTLY calibrated statistic, because the 100 test maps share one 100-member ensemble.
headline_findings.4_residual_limitation_of_the_chi2_branch: even after the fix the chi2 branch is mildly anti-conservative: on exactly Gaussian data it rejects at 0.0577 instead of 0.05, because with an ESTIMATED covariance the exact small-sample reference is Hotelling's T^2 (an F distribution), not chi2, and the Hartlap factor corrects the mean of the inverse covariance rather than the whole distribution. The pooled-exchangeable rank p-value has no such residual (0.0511 against an exact 0.0495) and is the one to prefer.
headline_findings.5_the_gate_itself_has_a_false_failure_ra: the declared '#{p<0.05} <= 9 of 100' clause fails with probability 0.08 per curve for a perfectly calibrated statistic under the F3 design (variance inflation 1.67 from the shared ensemble). This is a property of the F3 design (commit 033f017), not of the fix.
headline_findings.6_negative_controls_do_reject: 20 maps drawn at beam FWHM 6 deg against the 3 deg ensemble: #{chi2 p < 0.05} = 20/20, 20/20, 20/20 for b0, b1, Euler (median p 8.56e-45, 6.47e-46, 2.66e-05). The statistic can fail.
headline_findings.7_regression_guard_fails_on_the_original: the guard is green on the fixed library and fails on 19 tests when the original implementations are substituted
